scope: Prevent TABLE fallback graph preflight from reading INSERT payload fields through a public eType tag when the actual runtime object is unrelated.

implementation.guard: prepareTableFallbackGraph now uses exactEntityForDxfWrite<DRW_Insert>(entity, DRW::INSERT) after matching the source handle and tag. The existing fallback is admitted only when its runtime class is exactly DRW_Insert and its common INSERT projection matches the typed TABLE.
implementation.test: A locally authored one-cell semantic TABLE retains its normal DRW_Insert projection. The test substitutes a DRW_Point carrying the same handle and INSERT tag, checks refusal and destination preservation, restores the original projection, retries on the same dx_iface and reads back the TABLE text in ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1 CTest; selector covers ASCII and Binary DXF, refusal, destination preservation, same-adapter retry and typed readback.
validation.fixturePolicy: Generated from local objects; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: This proves adapter preflight runtime-type integrity and generated DXF transport only; it does not qualify ACAD_TABLE producer breadth, cell semantics, native rendering or consumer behavior.
P8 and the parent P5 TABLE gates remain open. No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
